verdict.rationale: Luma's own docs describe Luma Agents built into its browser-based creative workspace. The agents research, generate, and refine multi-step video, image, audio, and text work, which is a built-in assistant users can delegate tasks to. Luma Skills adds reusable workflows, but the evidence is marketing-level taglines rather than detailed docs. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how tasks are handed off and supervised inside the app, which task types the agent handles on its own, and independent or hands-on confirmation of the agent workflow.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
